parameter.name: Manifold Absolute Pressure
parameter.desc: P7-Pressure value calculated from the manifold absolute pressure sensor (absolute value)

parameter.name: Throttle Opening Angle
parameter.desc: P13-Engine throttle opening angle.

parameter.name: Fuel Injector #1 Pulse Width
parameter.desc: P21-This parameter includes injector latency.

parameter.name: Fuel Injector #2 Pulse Width
parameter.desc: P22-This parameter includes injector latency.

parameter.name: Knock Correction Advance
parameter.desc: P23-Retard amount when knocking has occurred. Partial learned value of the learned ignition timing.

parameter.name: Manifold Relative Pressure
parameter.desc: P25-Manifold Absolute Pressure [P7] minus current Atmospheric Pressure [P24].

parameter.name: Learned Ignition Timing
parameter.desc: P29-Advance or retard amount when knocking has occurred.

parameter.name: Accelerator Pedal Angle
parameter.desc: P30-Accelerator pedal angle.

parameter.name: Learned Ignition Timing Correction
parameter.desc: P153-Value of only the whole learning value in the ignition timing learning value.

parameter.name: Engine Load (Calculated)
parameter.desc: P200-Engine load as calculated from MAF and RPM.

parameter.name: Injector Duty Cycle
parameter.desc: P201-IDC as calculated from RPM and injector PW.

parameter.name: Manifold Relative Pressure (Corrected)
parameter.desc: P202-Difference between Manifold Absolute Pressure and Atmospheric Pressure.

parameter.name: Global Timing User Adjustment Value
parameter.desc: P239-This is the fixed amount of timing removed globally - set by the user

parameter.name: Engine Idle Speed User Adjustment (A/C off)
parameter.desc: P240-This is the fixed amount of idle speed adjustmnet while the A/C is off - set by the user

parameter.name: Engine Idle Speed User Adjustment (A/C on)
parameter.desc: P241-This is the fixed amount of idle speed adjustmnet while the A/C is on - set by the user

parameter.name: A/F Correction #2 (4-byte)*
parameter.desc: E105-A higher resolution alternative to the standard SSM A/F Correction #2 parameter.

parameter.name: Final Fueling Base (4-byte)*
parameter.desc: E123-This is the final fueling multiplier after corrections are applied but before per injector compensation.

parameter.name: Engine Load (4-Byte)*
parameter.desc: E32-This is the current engine load (g/rev) as determined by the ECU.

parameter.name: CL/OL Fueling*
parameter.desc: E33-Fuel system status. [8 = CL (normal)][10 = OL (normal)][7 = OL insufficient ECT][14 = OL due to system failure]

parameter.name: Fuel Injector #1 Latency (4-byte)*
parameter.desc: E50-Current injector latency as determined by the Injector Latency table.

parameter.name: Manifold Absolute Pressure (4-byte)*
parameter.desc: E51-MAP is limited to about 37 psi absolute (about 22 psig at sea level). This parameter has no effective limit.

parameter.name: Fuel Injector #1 Pulse Width (4-byte)*
parameter.desc: E60-Fuel Injector #1 PW with higher resolution. Note: This parameter does not include latency unlike the standard parameter.

parameter.name: A/F Correction #1 (4-byte)*
parameter.desc: E81-A higher precision alternative to the standard SSM A/F Correction #1 parameter.

parameter.name: Primary Open Loop Map Enrichment (4-byte)*
parameter.desc: E84-Primary enrichment value based on the Primary Open Loop Fueling table(s) Note: this value is NOT the final fueling target.

parameter.name: External Wideband AFR (D2WD610H master)*
parameter.desc: Master-patch external-wideband value at FFFFB098, presented primarily as gasoline AFR using 14.64 stoich. The former MAF ADC feeds both synthetic front feedback banks. A raw value of 0.0 is the firmware fault sentinel and must never be interpreted as a real AFR.

parameter.name: External Wideband Input ADC (D2WD610H master)*
parameter.desc: Unsigned former-MAF ADC at FFFFAB06. Use counts/volts to compare the ECU-referenced B136-23 input with the controller's white-to-black output and diagnose wiring, ground offset, or clipping; an in-range value does not prove controller health.

parameter.name: External Wideband Ready Metric (D2WD610H master)*
parameter.desc: Master-patch synthetic voltage-window metric at FFFFAE70. Firmware publishes 50.0 for an input inside the configured plausibility window and 0.0 outside it. It is not controller/sensor health. Closed-loop feedback requires greater than 35.0; EBCS duty additionally requires valid MAP/RPM/IAT, minimum control RPM, and a non-fault speed-density result.

parameter.name: Committed AVLS VE State (D2WD610H master)*
parameter.desc: Committed AVLS mode byte at FFFFCD86 used directly by the dual-VE airflow wrapper. Value 1 is low lift and value 3 is high lift. Filter VE correction logs by this committed state and discard samples around the transition; do not substitute requested state.

parameter.name: Lean Fuel Cut State (D2WD610H master)*
parameter.desc: Latched lean-protection state at FFFFC860: 0 disarmed, 1 post-turbo sensor delay, 2 monitoring AFR, 3 fuel-cut latched. State 3 releases only after MAP falls below the configured barometric reset pressure.

parameter.name: Lean Fuel Cut Counter (D2WD610H master)*
parameter.desc: Current post-turbo transport-delay or consecutive-lean confirmation count at FFFFC85C. Counts periodic task calls, not milliseconds; log it to calibrate the installed sensor delay.

parameter.name: CL/OL State Flags (D2WD610H master)*
parameter.desc: Raw stock closed-loop/open-loop state byte at FFFFBE38. Pressure safety clears bit 0x80 to revoke closed-loop permission; use the stock logger's final fueling status where available for a human-readable state.

parameter.name: Engine Run Counter (D2WD610H diagnostic)*
parameter.desc: Stock saturating engine-run counter at FFFFB688. It increments in the main periodic engine task and resets while the engine-not-running state is active. The approximately 10 ms/count interpretation is derived from scheduler behavior and must be confirmed from the capture.

parameter.name: After-Start Fuel Group A (D2WD610H diagnostic)*
parameter.desc: Raw additive after-start fueling state at FFFFB834, published by the Ghidra-identified group-A decay path and consumed by final fueling. Log from before cranking until the lean trend is complete.

parameter.name: After-Start Fuel Group B (D2WD610H diagnostic)*
parameter.desc: Raw additive after-start fueling state at FFFFB854, published by the Ghidra-identified group-B decay path and consumed by final fueling. Log from before cranking until the lean trend is complete.

parameter.name: After-Start Fuel Compensation A (D2WD610H diagnostic)*
parameter.desc: Raw after-start fueling compensation state at FFFFB868, published by the Ghidra-identified B868 update path and consumed by final fueling.

parameter.name: After-Start Fuel Compensation B (D2WD610H diagnostic)*
parameter.desc: Raw after-start fueling compensation state at FFFFB874, published by the Ghidra-identified B874 update path and consumed by final fueling.

parameter.name: After-Start Fuel Group C (D2WD610H diagnostic)*
parameter.desc: Raw group-C after-start fueling output at FFFFBE40. Its Ghidra-identified residual path uses the engine-run counter and a 5000-call calibration before the residual state decays; final fueling consumes this output.

parameter.name: After-Start Fuel Group D (D2WD610H diagnostic)*
parameter.desc: Raw group-D after-start fueling output at FFFFBE48, published by the Ghidra-identified group-D update path and consumed by final fueling.

switch.name: Cruise Control Inhibitor Switch
switch.desc: S132-Becomes ON(1) in Park or Neutral. ECU input.

ecuparam.name: IAM (4-byte)*
ecuparam.desc: E31-KCA = (KA (max) map value * IAM) + FBKC + FLKC. Total Timing = KCA + base timing + timing compensations

ecuparam.name: Feedback Knock Correction (4-byte)*
ecuparam.desc: E39-This is the temporary negative correction to timing advance in response to what the ECU perceives as knock.

ecuparam.name: Knock Correction Advance (IAM only)*
ecuparam.desc: E40-Knock Correction Advance (IAM only)

ecuparam.name: Fine Learning Knock Correction (4-byte)*
ecuparam.desc: E41-Current learned correction that is being applied which is stored and applied across specific load and rpm ranges.

ecuparam.name: A/F Learning #1 A (Stored)*
ecuparam.desc: E44-A/F learned correction to CL and OL fueling across specific air flow ranges based on short-term A/F Correction witin range.

ecuparam.name: A/F Learning #1 B (Stored)*
ecuparam.desc: E45-A/F learned correction to CL and OL fueling across specific air flow ranges based on short-term A/F Correction witin range.

ecuparam.name: A/F Learning #1 C (Stored)*
ecuparam.desc: E46-A/F learned correction to CL and OL fueling across specific air flow ranges based on short-term A/F Correction witin range.

ecuparam.name: A/F Learning #1 D (Stored)*
ecuparam.desc: E47-A/F learned correction to CL and OL fueling across specific air flow ranges based on short-term A/F Correction witin range.

ecuparam.name: A/F Learning #1 (4-byte)*
ecuparam.desc: E48-Current A/F Learning being applied. Higher resolution then the standard SSM A/F Learning #1 parameter.

ecuparam.name: Ignition Base Timing*
ecuparam.desc: E53-Current base ignition timing as determined by the Base Timing tables.

ecuparam.name: Tip-in Throttle*
ecuparam.desc: E54-This is the current throttle angle change % used as an input by the Throttle Tip-in Enrichment table.

ecuparam.name: Tip-in Enrichment (Last Calculated)*
ecuparam.desc: E55-Current (or last) calculated tip-in enrichment value. The value is not cleared, effectively shows the last calculated value.

ecuparam.name: Requested Torque*
ecuparam.desc: E56-Current requested torque which is used as an input to the Target Throttle Plate Position (Requested Torque) table.

ecuparam.name: Target Throttle Plate Position*
ecuparam.desc: E57-Current target throttle plate position as determined by the Target Throttle Plate Position (Requested Torque) table.

ecuparam.name: Fine Learning Table Offset*
ecuparam.desc: E58-Current index position for the Fine Learning Knock Correction table being applied (and potentially adjusted), stored in ram.

ecuparam.name: Gear (Calculated)*
ecuparam.desc: E59-Current manual transmission gear selection as estimated by the ECU based on vehicle speed and RPM.

ecuparam.name: A/F Learning Airflow Range (Current)*
ecuparam.desc: E61-Current stored A/F Learning index position. A value of 1-4 corresponds to airflow ranges A-D respectively.

ecuparam.name: A/F Learning #2 A (Stored)*
ecuparam.desc: E62-A/F learned correction to CL and OL fueling across specific air flow ranges based on short-term A/F Correction witin range.

ecuparam.name: A/F Learning #2 B (Stored)*
ecuparam.desc: E63-A/F learned correction to CL and OL fueling across specific air flow ranges based on short-term A/F Correction witin range.

ecuparam.name: A/F Learning #2 C (Stored)*
ecuparam.desc: E64-A/F learned correction to CL and OL fueling across specific air flow ranges based on short-term A/F Correction witin range.

ecuparam.name: A/F Learning #2 D (Stored)*
ecuparam.desc: E65-A/F learned correction to CL and OL fueling across specific air flow ranges based on short-term A/F Correction witin range.

ecuparam.name: A/F Learning #2 (4-byte)*
ecuparam.desc: E66-Current A/F Learning being applied. Higher resolution then the standard SSM A/F Learning #2 parameter.

ecuparam.name: A/F Sensor #1 (4-byte)*
ecuparam.desc: E91-A higher precision alternative to the standard SSM A/F Sensor #1 (AFR/lambda) parameter.

ecuparam.name: A/F Sensor #2 (4-byte)*
ecuparam.desc: E109-A higher resolution alternative to the standard SSM A/F Sensor #2 parameter.

ecuparam.name: Manifold Relative Pressure (4-byte)*
ecuparam.desc: E113-Actual relative boost pressure and therefore will match a boost gauge regardless of local atmospheric pressure. No limit.

ecuparam.name: Closed Loop Fueling Target (4-byte)*
ecuparam.desc: E121-This is the closed loop fueling lambda target which is used in determining short-term corrections (A/F Correction #1).
